red-herring-stall-neighbor.desc: the keeper of the next stall

s3-suspect.desc: a young man from the market

free-bowl.1.1.line: A queue of twelve people stretches back from the noodle stall where {boss-careless} ladles.

free-bowl.1.2.line: {extra:patron} slides a folded slip under an empty bowl and pushes it across the counter.

free-bowl.1.3.line: {boss-careless} lifts the empty bowl and tucks the folded slip into the lid rack.

free-bowl.2.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} stop at the noodle stall on their patrol.

free-bowl.2.2.line: {inside-officer} eats the bowl {boss-careless} serves, and no coins go down on the counter.

free-bowl.2.3.line: {boss-careless} nods at {inside-officer} across the steam of the pots.

free-bowl.2.4.line: {framed-officer} sets two coins on the counter for {framed-officer.his} bowl.

bench-lunch.1.1.line: {informant} sits down on the bench by the vending machines.

bench-lunch.1.2.line: {informant} opens a paper bag lunch and eats on the bench.

bench-lunch.1.3.line: {informant} turns toward the noodle stall, then looks down at the ground.

bench-lunch.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} stands at the far corner a while, then sits on the same bench as {informant}.

bench-lunch.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} gets up from the bench and says to {informant}: "Same bench tomorrow."

bench-lunch.1.6.line: {burnout-officer} sits on a nearby seat and stays there for forty minutes.

bench-lunch.1.7.line: {burnout-officer} shrugs at nobody in particular: "I will finish the fire report tomorrow."

bowl-tower.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} leaves the noodle stall carrying a tower of six lidded bowls.

bowl-tower.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} walks past the seats with the bowls, and no lid comes off.

bowl-tower.2.1.line: {rookie-officer} stops at the noodle stall's lid rack, where a stencil numbers the lids 11 to 17.

bowl-tower.2.2.line: {rookie-officer} points at the stencil and reads it aloud: "Eleven to seventeen."

bowl-tower.2.3.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} shouts at {go-between-courier} across the stall line: "Rent is rent."

bowl-tower.2.4.line: {go-between-courier} shrugs at {red-herring-stall-neighbor} and says nothing back.

wrong-door.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 6B and waits in the dark corridor.

wrong-door.1.2.line: Nobody answers door 6B, and {red-herring-night-courier} walks back down the corridor.

wrong-door.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at door 4C and waits, a lidded bowl in one hand.

wrong-door.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} hands {extra:resident} one lidded bowl and gets a thin paper bag back.

wrong-door.1.5.line: {go-between-courier} walks off toward the lift with the thin paper bag.

scan-skipped.1.1.line: {inside-officer} scans the stalls to the left and the right of the noodle stall.

scan-skipped.1.2.line: {inside-officer} walks past the noodle stall without raising the scanner.

scan-skipped.1.3.line: {framed-officer} reads the scan sheet twice: the noodle stall line is blank.

scan-skipped.1.4.line: {framed-officer} writes something in a paper notebook and keeps it in {framed-officer.his} pocket.

scan-skipped.2.1.line: {inside-officer} leads {framed-officer} on a longer route that bends past the noodle stall.

scan-skipped.2.2.line: {framed-officer} says to {inside-officer}: "We always turn left at this corner."

scan-skipped.3.1.line: Behind a pillar, comm, one side, {inside-officer}: "Not here."

scan-skipped.3.2.line: {boss-careless} waves at {inside-officer} from behind the counter.

empty-bowls.1.1.line: {extra:resident} leaves 4C with a sack of empty lidded bowls over one shoulder.

empty-bowls.2.1.line: {go-between-courier} steps into the tenement lift alone.

empty-bowls.2.2.line: The lift panel lights at floor 4 as the doors close on {go-between-courier}.

empty-bowls.2.3.line: In the corridor, comm, one side, {family-caller-officer}: "Not now, Mama."

empty-bowls.2.4.line: Comm, one side, {family-caller-officer} again, quieter: "Put him on."

empty-bowls.2.5.line: {family-caller-officer} walks to the stairs with the comm still at {family-caller-officer.his} ear.

machine-dark.1.1.line: {informant} carries a crate back to the vending machine and starts the restock.

machine-dark.1.2.line: {informant} takes the far lane around the square, not past the noodle stall.

machine-dark.2.1.line: {veteran-officer} stands at the vending machine, its light dark.

machine-dark.2.2.line: {veteran-officer} reads a sign taped to the dark machine: "restock Thursday," with no initials.

machine-dark.2.3.line: Comm, one side, {veteran-officer}: "No, nobody has seen the restocker."

route-slip.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} walk {s1-mugger} in through the station door.

route-slip.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} empties {s1-mugger}'s pocket onto the counter, a folded slip among the coins.

route-slip.2.1.line: {rookie-officer} unfolds the slip: seven stall numbers from the square and "pay Fri" in pencil.

route-slip.2.2.line: {rookie-officer} taps each stall number on the slip in front of {s1-mugger}.

route-slip.2.3.line: {s1-mugger} tells {rookie-officer} the bowls came from a runner at the Square and went to doors off the list.

parcel-lid.1.1.line: {family-caller-officer} lifts a parcel from a doorstep and turns it over.

parcel-lid.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} opens a false bottom in the parcel, and a label under it reads "lid 14."

parcel-lid.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} points at the label and holds the parcel up to the corridor light.

parcel-lid.1.4.line: {red-herring-night-courier} runs down the stairs, a bag bouncing at {red-herring-night-courier.his} side.

parcel-lid.1.6.line: {veteran-officer} waves {rookie-officer} back up from the landing.

arson-suspect.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} stands beside the burnt stall in the market plaza.

arson-suspect.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} hands a thin paper bag to {s3-suspect} at the edge of the burnt stall.

arson-suspect.1.4.line: {burnout-officer} walks {s3-suspect} across the plaza toward the station.

arson-suspect.2.1.line: {burnout-officer} sits on the plaza steps and stays there for forty minutes.

arson-suspect.2.2.line: {burnout-officer} eats cold noodles out of a carton on the steps.

label-and-feed.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the payment label on a recovered parcel: {framed-officer}'s badge number, in a looped hand.

label-and-feed.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the looped digits and turns the label toward {framed-officer}.

label-and-feed.1.3.line: {framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} over the label: "Those digits are not my hand."

label-and-feed.2.1.line: {framed-officer} opens {framed-officer.his} notebook to a page: "Lift lobby duty, 14:00 to 14:30."

label-and-feed.2.2.line: A mesh post from the station terminal goes up on {desk-sergeant}'s screen: {framed-officer}'s badge number and "200, paid."

suspended-on-screens.1.1.line: The screen shows a notice: "{framed-officer}, suspended pending review."

suspended-on-screens.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} posts the suspension notice to the station feed from the front desk.

suspended-on-screens.1.3.line: {framed-officer} stands in front of the screen and does not move.

suspended-on-screens.1.4.line: {inside-officer} walks past {framed-officer} holding a single cup and does not stop.

suspended-on-screens.1.5.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} stands outside the station screens for ten minutes, reading.

tray-empty.1.1.line: {inside-officer} steps up to the evidence counter before the day shift comes in.

tray-empty.1.2.line: {inside-officer} leaves the evidence counter with a flat box under one arm.

tray-empty.2.1.line: {framed-officer} pulls out the evidence tray, and it is empty.

tray-empty.2.2.line: {framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} over the evidence log on the counter.

tray-empty.2.3.line: {desk-sergeant} shrugs at {framed-officer} and turns back to the station screens.

door-6b.1.1.line: {framed-officer} waits alone in the dark corridor outside {inside-officer}'s door.

door-6b.1.2.line: {framed-officer} knocks on {inside-officer}'s door and waits, and nobody answers.

door-6b.1.3.line: Down the hall, {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 6B and waits with a bag.

door-6b.1.4.line: {extra:partner} opens door 6B, and {red-herring-night-courier} and {extra:partner} hug in the doorway.

door-6b.1.5.line: {red-herring-night-courier} opens the bag for {extra:partner}: flowers and a loaf of bread.

door-6b.1.6.line: {framed-officer} walks back toward the lift without knocking again.

stakeout-hand-over.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands watching the lift hall, a paper cup on the ledge beside {night-stakeout-officer.him}.

stakeout-hand-over.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} is back at the lift hall, the paper cup on the same ledge.

stakeout-hand-over.2.2.line: {inside-officer} hands {go-between-courier} a folded sheet at the lift doors.

stakeout-hand-over.2.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} steps off the wall and arrests {go-between-courier} at the lift doors.

shutter-down.1.1.line: {inside-officer} walks to the noodle stall before opening, the square still empty.

shutter-down.1.2.line: {inside-officer} passes a folded sheet over the counter to {boss-careless}.

shutter-down.1.3.line: {inside-officer} leaves the stall without ordering anything.

shutter-down.1.4.line: {boss-careless} pulls the shutter down over the noodle stall before the lunch hour.

shutter-down.1.5.line: A landlord receipt taped to {red-herring-stall-neighbor}'s shutter is stamped "paid."

shutter-down.1.6.line: {red-herring-stall-neighbor} unloads crates of stock into {red-herring-stall-neighbor.his} stall.

flat-4c.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at door 4C and wait.

flat-4c.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} opens 4C with the landlord's key and steps in with {rookie-officer}.

flat-4c.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} searches the flat: bowl lids stacked by the sink, and no ledger anywhere.

flat-4c.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} picks up a bowl lid stenciled "14" and turns it over.

flat-4c.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} shrugs at {veteran-officer} in the middle of the swept, empty flat.

found-on-the-lawn.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} walks out onto the lawn, looking along the blankets.

found-on-the-lawn.1.2.line: {informant} sits alone on a blanket on the lawn, head down.

found-on-the-lawn.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} asks {informant} a question, waits a minute, and asks it again.

found-on-the-lawn.1.4.line: {informant} hands {veteran-officer} a sheet of handwritten lid numbers.

found-on-the-lawn.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} and {informant} walk off the lawn together toward the station.

cleared-on-the-screens.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} reads the terminal log: "Mesh post 14:02, signed in as {inside-officer}."

cleared-on-the-screens.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a correction to the station feed under the notice about {framed-officer}.

cleared-on-the-screens.1.3.line: {framed-officer} reads the corrected screen, then reads it again.

cleared-on-the-screens.1.4.line: {framed-officer} hands {desk-sergeant} {framed-officer.his} paper notebook across the desk.

cleared-on-the-screens.1.5.line: {inside-officer} walks past the screen without looking up at it.

arrest-at-the-stall.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands across from the noodle stall, watching the counter.

arrest-at-the-stall.1.2.line: The lunch queue forms at the noodle stall while {boss-careless} sets out the bowls.

arrest-at-the-stall.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks to the counter and arrests {boss-careless} with the ladle still in hand.

arrest-at-the-stall.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} opens {inside-officer}'s locker and lifts out a flat box.

arrest-at-the-stall.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stretches police tape across the shuttered noodle stall.

arrest-at-the-stall.2.2.line: The lunch queue breaks up and drifts away from the taped stall.

care-scan-logs-shared.1.1.line: Comm, one side, {desk-sergeant} to station 2: "Send the hour sheets."

care-scan-logs-shared.1.2.line: {extra:runner} hands {desk-sergeant} a printout of the station 2 hour sheets.

care-scan-logs-shared.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the noodle stall line on the printout, the same hour every day.

care-early-stakeout.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} takes up a post at the lift hall and stays there.

care-early-stakeout.1.2.line: {inside-officer} hands {go-between-courier} a folded sheet at the lift doors.

care-early-stakeout.2.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} steps off the wall and arrests {go-between-courier} at the lift doors.

care-tray-in-the-locker.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} open {inside-officer}'s locker at the station.

care-tray-in-the-locker.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} lifts a flat box out of the locker.

care-tray-in-the-locker.2.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at door 4C and wait.

care-tray-in-the-locker.2.2.line: {rookie-officer} searches 4C and finds bowl lids stacked by the sink.

care-arrest-at-the-stall.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} arrests {boss-careless} at the noodle stall counter.

care-arrest-at-the-stall.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stretches police tape across the noodle stall.

care-corrected-on-the-screens.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a correction to the station feed under the notice about {framed-officer}.

care-corrected-on-the-screens.1.2.line: {framed-officer} reads the corrected screen, then reads it again.

care-corrected-on-the-screens.1.3.line: {framed-officer} hands {desk-sergeant} {framed-officer.his} paper notebook across the desk.

care-tea-cart.1.1.line: At a tea cart one stall down from the noodle stall, {go-between-bartender} serves {extra:regular} first.

care-tea-cart.1.2.line: The line at the tea cart stacks up while {go-between-bartender} stands with empty hands.

care-tea-cart.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} passes {extra:regular} a paper tab and no drink.

care-tea-cart.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} closes up the tea cart and leaves by the service lane.

care-pass-at-the-lift.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} bumps shoulders with {go-between-bartender} in the lift hall.

care-pass-at-the-lift.1.2.line: A bowl lid passes from {go-between-courier}'s hand to {go-between-bartender}'s hand.

care-pass-at-the-lift.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} and {go-between-bartender} walk to different doors without a word.

care-second-station.1.1.line: {inside-officer-extra} sits a little apart from the others at the station 2 briefing.

care-second-station.1.3.line: {inside-officer-extra} asks {desk-sergeant} what station 1 is working on this week.

care-second-station.1.4.line: {inside-officer-extra} is the first one out of the briefing.

care-cart-takes-the-route.1.1.line: {boss-careful} raises the noodle stall shutter and starts serving the first bowls.

care-cart-takes-the-route.1.2.line: {go-between-bartender} carries a tower of lidded bowls from the noodle stall to the lift.

care-cart-takes-the-route.1.3.line: Comm, one side, {inside-officer}, turning away from the stalls: "Not here."

care-cart-takes-the-route.1.4.line: {inside-officer} hands {extra:messenger} a folded sheet and walks on.

care-locker-key.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} finds a locker key tag tucked inside a bowl lid, stamped "Foundry locker 9."

care-locker-key.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} takes the key tag from {rookie-officer} and holds it to the light.

care-locker-key.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} points at the stamp on the tag and shows {rookie-officer} the foundry number.

care-locker-key.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} walk out to the lift together.

care-locker-room.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} enter the foundry locker room.

care-locker-room.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} opens locker 9: empty, with a ring from a bowl lid left on the shelf.

care-locker-room.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits outside the foundry service door, watching the lane.

care-locker-room.1.4.line: {inside-officer-extra} leaves the foundry by the back door.

care-arrest-on-the-stakeout.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands across from the noodle stall, watching the counter.

care-arrest-on-the-stakeout.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks to the counter and arrests {boss-careful} with the ladle still in hand.

care-arrest-on-the-stakeout.1.6.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stretches police tape across the noodle stall.
